title: Closed Wallpaper Gallery payload release
scope: New Tab lifetime / retained secondary UI DOM

before.behavior: lazy shell and its last rendered wallpaper-choice payload remain attached after close

after.behavior: shell remains mounted, dynamic choice payload is released on native dialog close and rebuilt before the next showModal

auditedNegativeControls: Bookmarks close already resets dynamic tree arrays and DOM payload
Shortcut-editor close already cancels detected-favicon work and clears candidate DOM
Custom Branding close already invalidates upload ownership and releases the in-memory draft
canonical-host, locale-catalog, background-preload, favicon-choice and Recovery-decode caches are explicitly bounded
image optimizer clears completed/failed worker requests and terminates its idle worker
correctnessBoundaries: Wallpaper Gallery module/shell remains lazy and memoized
Settings ownership-generation revalidation before first gallery mount is unchanged
gallery contents are rebuilt synchronously before showModal on every open
background selection/persistence and image-preload behavior are unchanged
no Sync, Recovery, permission, schema, network or privacy behavior changes
